newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIA selling Raffles City, RC Hotels stakes.
newsitem.headline: SIA selling Raffles City, RC Hotels stakes.

text.p: Singapore Airlines Ltd (SIA) said on Monday it had signed a conditional agreement to sell its shares in Raffles City (Private) Ltd (RCPL) and in RC Hotels (Pte) Ltd (RCHL) to DBS Land for a minimum consideration of about Singapore $100.2 million.

SIA said in an announcement to the stock exchange that the sales would be linked to an expected initial public offer (IPO) of shares in Raffles Holdings (1995) Pte Ltd (RHL), currently a wholly-owned subsidiary of DBS Land. SIA would sell its entire 5.37 percent interest or 28.4 million shares in RCPL and its entire 5.37 percent stake or 537,000 shares in RCHL.

The price for each RCPL share would be based on a formula involving net tangible asset value adjusted for any premium or discount of RHL's IPO offer price over RHL's assessed net book value per share and a tentative base price of S$3.44 depending on whether the IPO takes place on or before December 31, 1997.
SIA added the price of each RCHL share would be based on the prevailing net tangible asset value per RCHL share and a base price of S$4.88, again depending on the completion.
Based on the formulae, SIA said the minimum consideration for RCPL shares would be about S$97.6 million and RCHL S$2.6 million.

Completion of the acquisition, subject to approval of DBS Land shareholders, would take place before RHL's IPO launch. SIA said the divestment would not have any material impact on group net tangible assets and earnings per share for the financial year ending March 31, 1997. -- Singapore newsroom 65-8703080
